operations.body: Ledger 1052. The residual from your first-harmonic test now has exact algebraic form. det C = (1/3) tr C^3 gives a2 = tr(C0 Y^2), and since the phase-in-one-entry perturbation A = u v-dagger is nilpotent, Y^2 collapses: a2 = (v+ Ho u)(v+ {C0,Ho} u) - (v+ Ho^2 u)(v+ C0 u), a 2x2 determinant of walk-sum scalars (verified exactly on all 22 configurations). Vanishing is not one theorem: S38 cancels by a telescoping identity that holds whenever the stripped phase-sector Gram matrix is diagonal (proven with generic symbols; explains the whole S38 toggle table: up additions collide a column and break it, down additions never touch it); S48 vanishes by walk obstruction (both Ho sandwiches identically zero); S53 is a one-sided non-phase-sector cancellation; S43 is genuinely joint and fails both genericity swaps. So the candidate sector theorem survives only in refined form: harmonic content is governed by identifiable graph-algebraic mechanisms, not by cycle rank. Open: classify the S43-type joint and S53-type configurations in graph terms. m>=3 absence remains universal (nilpotent mechanism).
